text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky thoroughly enjoyed running in 
the Japan Derby, a race one can only enter 
once in a lifetime.

The Trainer suggests the ultimate stage 
for the returning Maruzensky to show the 
world her running... A challenge at the 
Arima Kinen.

Though surprised, she accepted the 
proposal and set her sights on her next 
goal: the Arima Kinen.
